subject: general
question: A man goes to his office from his house at the speed of 5 km/h and returns to his house using the same route at the speed of 20 km/h. The average speed during the journey is:
solution:
Concept Used:

Average speed = Total distance/total time taken

Formula used: 

2xy/(x + y) km/hr

Where,x is first speed and y is second speed.
